name: Template: Customer Success
description: Track account health from onboarding through expansion and renewal. Each swimlane represents a customer account.

swimlanes.name: Acme Corp
swimlanes.notes: Mid-market. 50 seats. Champion: Head of Ops. 90-day onboarding started 2026-02-01.

swimlanes.name: Brightfield Energy
swimlanes.notes: At-risk account. Usage dropped 40% MoM. Champion: Lisa Markov (Digital Director).

swimlanes.name: NovaTech Solutions
swimlanes.notes: Healthy account. Expanding organically. CTO is a vocal advocate.

swimlanes.name: Clearwater Bank
swimlanes.notes: Financial sector — slow procurement. CISO approval required for all vendor tools.

swimlanes.name: Zephyr Logistics
swimlanes.notes: Churned 2026-02-28. Contract not renewed. Re-engagement planned for Q4.

cards.title: Admin training session — 2 teams
cards.description:
Schedule and deliver two 60-min admin training sessions covering:

- Board setup and swimlane configuration
- User management and roles
- Integrations (Slack, webhooks)

Target: Ops team (25 users) and Engineering team (25 users).

comments.body: Session 1 done — great turnout (22/25 attended). Session 2 booked for next Tuesday.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Import historical project data from Trello
cards.description:
Acme has 3 years of project history in Trello they want imported. Estimated: 800 cards across 6 boards.

Use the CSV import tool. Map Trello lists → Visiban columns.

comments.body: Trello JSON exported. Working on conversion script.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: First board created and team invited
cards.description:
Acme Ops team has created their first board and invited all 25 members. Initial adoption looks strong — 18/25 users active in week 1.

Next: ensure Engineering team mirrors the structure.

checklist.text: Confirm all users can log in

comments.body: Head of Ops is a strong champion — already coaching colleagues on WIP limits.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: 45-day QBR — health check
cards.description:
Quarterly Business Review at the 45-day mark.

## Agenda

1. Usage metrics review (WAU, boards created, cards moved)
2. Feedback on pain points
3. Expansion discussion (5 additional seats for Design team)
4. Renewal timeline (due 2026-08-01)

checklist.text: Pull usage report from admin panel

cards.title: Re-engagement call with Lisa Markov
cards.description:
Outcome of intervention call:

- Reorg is complete — 3 new team leads added
- Lisa will personally onboard the new leads
- Usage expected to recover within 30 days

Risk level: reduced from Critical to Watch.

checklist.text: Send onboarding resources to new leads

comments.body: Call went well. Lisa is re-engaged and confident in recovery.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: At-risk recovery plan — 30-day milestones
cards.description:
Documented recovery plan agreed with Lisa Markov:

- Week 1: New team leads onboarded
- Week 2: First board created by each new lead
- Week 4: WAU back to ≥ 30

CS will check in weekly.

cards.title: Usage dropped 40% — intervention needed
cards.description:
Monthly active users fell from 35 to 21 between February and March. No boards created in the last 3 weeks.

Hypothesis: team restructure following M&A activity. Champion Lisa Markov is still in role — schedule urgent call.

checklist.text: Confirm champion is still in role
Pull full usage breakdown by user

comments.body: Lisa confirmed she's still in role but team reorg has slowed adoption.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Call booked for Thursday. Preparing tailored re-engagement deck.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Expansion: 3 additional teams (60 seats)
cards.description:
Following recovery, Brightfield wants to expand to 3 additional teams. Current: 35 seats. Proposed: 95 seats.

Opportunity ACV uplift: +$14,400.

cards.title: Onboarding complete — all 3 teams active
cards.description:
NovaTech completed onboarding ahead of schedule. All 3 teams (Engineering, Product, Design) have active boards.

WAU: 42/45 users. NPS at 30-day mark: 67.

comments.body: CTO mentioned Visiban in a company all-hands. Great advocate.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Expansion: 3 new teams want access
cards.description:
Inbound request from CTO: Sales, Support, and HR teams want Visiban boards. Current contract: 45 seats. New request: 90 seats total.

Route to AE for expansion proposal.

comments.body: AE briefed. Sending expansion proposal this week.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Renewal — 2-year deal discussion
cards.description:
Current contract expires 2026-09-01. CTO interested in a 2-year deal with the expanded seat count.

Potential ACV: $28,800/year for 90 seats on 2-year term.

cards.title: CISO approval for data residency
cards.description:
Clearwater Bank requires CISO sign-off before any data is entered. Key requirement: all data must reside in their approved AWS region (us-east-1).

Provide architecture diagram and data flow documentation.

checklist.text: Confirm us-east-1 data residency in writing

comments.body: CISO review call booked for next Wednesday.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Security questionnaire (47 questions)
cards.description:
Clearwater InfoSec sent their standard 47-question vendor security form. Deadline: 2026-03-10 (OVERDUE).

Coordinate with InfoSec lead to complete within 2 business days.

comments.body: OVERDUE by 5 days. Escalated to InfoSec lead — expediting.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Adoption stalled at 30% — new team leads not onboarded
cards.description:
3 weeks post-launch, only 15/50 users are active (30%). Root cause: 4 team leads have not completed setup, so their teams are waiting.

Action: direct outreach to each team lead with a personalised setup guide.

comments.body: Outreach sent to all 4 leads. Two have responded and booked setup calls.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Executive sponsor re-engaged after champion call
cards.description:
The Head of Digital Banking (executive sponsor) attended the recovery call and is now actively promoting Visiban internally.

He has mandated all 8 project teams adopt Visiban by end of Q2.

comments.body: This changes the trajectory. Q2 mandate will drive adoption without CS intervention.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Q4 re-engagement campaign
cards.description:
Plan outreach to Zephyr for Q4 2026 based on:

1. Improved mobile UX (roadmap item for Q3)
2. New simplified onboarding flow
3. Pricing flexibility for logistics sector

Target contact: same IT Manager who gave positive exit feedback.

cards.title: Contract not renewed — churn confirmed
cards.description:
Zephyr Logistics did not renew their contract (expired 2026-02-28). Primary reason given: 'Tool too complex for our ops team.'

Secondary reason: budget cuts across the company.

checklist.text: Archive board data per retention policy

comments.body: Churn logged. Primary reason: complexity. Consider flagging UX feedback to product.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Exit interview completed
cards.description:
30-min exit interview with IT Manager.

Key feedback:
- Onboarding was too long (took 6 weeks)
- Mobile experience was poor for field workers
- Would consider returning if mobile UX improves

Filed UX feedback for product team: issues #312, #313.

comments.body: Good feedback. Mobile UX is a known gap — this reinforces the priority.
comments.author: demo1
